entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Joel Engel was a Russian music critic, composer and one of the leading figures in the Jewish art music movement. Born in the 
Russian Empire, and later moving to Berlin and then to Mandatory Palestine, Engel has been called "the true founding father of the modern renaissance of Jewish music."
